related.title: TypeScript 判別聯集：狀態機與窮盡檢查
related.titleEn: TypeScript discriminated unions: state machines and exhaustiveness
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付closure-trace.csv、環境圖與兩種共享狀態反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver closure-trace.csv, environment diagrams and both shared-state counterexamples.
related.difference: 把各狀態可用資料畫成表，success才有value、error才有reason；用switch及never檢查。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate allowed data per state: success hasvalue, error hasreason; use aswitch andnever check.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
閉包保留綁定而非必然複製當時數值；let迴圈每次建立不同綁定，var可共享同一函式綁定。
教學基準：3+3+3 = 9 sum；對照：0+1+2 = 3 sum。

判別欄位縮窄聯集，never可協助找出遺漏分支；型別通過不會替外部JSON做執行期驗證。
教學基準：3/4*100 = 75 percent_or_cases；對照：5-3 = 2 percent_or_cases。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Closures retain bindings rather than necessarily copying values; let loops create per-iteration bindings whilevar can share one function binding.
Teaching baseline: 3+3+3 = 9 sum; comparison: 0+1+2 = 3 sum.

A discriminant narrows unions andnever can expose missing branches; successful type checking does not validate external JSON at runtime.
Teaching baseline: 3/4*100 = 75 percent_or_cases; comparison: 5-3 = 2 percent_or_cases.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Git 三方合併：共同祖先與語意衝突
related.titleEn: Git three-way merge: common ancestors and semantic conflicts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付closure-trace.csv、環境圖與兩種共享狀態反例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver closure-trace.csv, environment diagrams and both shared-state counterexamples.
related.difference: 建立兩分支各改不同設定行，保留共同祖先並預測merge是否會有文字衝突。
related.differenceEn: Branch from one ancestor, edit separate config lines and predict whether textual conflict occurs.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
閉包保留綁定而非必然複製當時數值；let迴圈每次建立不同綁定，var可共享同一函式綁定。
教學基準：3+3+3 = 9 sum；對照：0+1+2 = 3 sum。

三方合併比較base、ours、theirs；文字自動合併成功不表示組合後行為正確。
教學基準：10*(2+1) = 30 s；對照：20*(4+1) = 100 s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Closures retain bindings rather than necessarily copying values; let loops create per-iteration bindings whilevar can share one function binding.
Teaching baseline: 3+3+3 = 9 sum; comparison: 0+1+2 = 3 sum.

Three-way merging compares base, ours andtheirs; textual success does not establish correct combined behavior.
Teaching baseline: 10*(2+1) = 30 s; comparison: 20*(4+1) = 100 s.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
